tasks.title: Promote the staged tracked_destinations migration and schema
tasks.dod: the tracked_destinations table + idx_tracked_destinations_user_created + FK to users applies and reverts cleanly via pnpm db:up / pnpm db:down

tasks.title: Add the shared UUIDv7 id-generation helper
tasks.dod: unit tests confirm src/lib/id.ts generates time-sortable UUIDv7 values with no collisions across 10k calls

tasks.title: Add the frozen five-entry destination catalogue
tasks.dod: unit tests assert the catalogue exposes exactly the five entries and a lookup that returns false for any reference not in it

tasks.title: Add the TrackedDestinationsRepository and its dependency builder
tasks.dod: integration tests (pglite) assert insert, ownership-scoped get-by-id (zero rows for another owner), ownership-scoped delete, and list-ordered-by-created_at-then-id all behave as data-model.md specifies

tasks.title: Add the list-tracked-destinations use case
tasks.dod: unit tests assert recorded order (tie-broken by id), a confirmed-empty result distinct from a read failure, and a read failure returns the typed recoverable-error result

tasks.title: Add the add-tracked-destination use case
tasks.dod: unit tests assert an unsupported reference is refused with destinations.unsupported_reference and writes nothing (tested at this layer directly, bypassing any picker), and a supported reference records and returns the new row including when a duplicate already exists

tasks.title: Add the remove-tracked-destination use case
tasks.dod: unit tests assert an ownership-scoped delete returns not_found identically for another owner's record, a removed one and a never-existed one, a successful delete confirms, and a delete failure leaves the row intact and returns a distinct not-removed result

tasks.title: Add the get-tracked-destination-by-id use case
tasks.dod: unit tests assert the ownership-scoped lookup returns the record for its owner and an identical not_found result for another owner's record, a removed one and a never-existed one, executing the same query shape in all three cases

tasks.title: Add GET/POST /api/v1/destinations route handlers
tasks.dod: route tests assert 200 with the ordered list, 401 revealing nothing unauthenticated, 201 with the recorded record on POST, 422 destinations.unsupported_reference on an unsupported reference, and every response matches contracts/openapi.yaml

tasks.title: Add GET/DELETE /api/v1/destinations/{trackedDestinationId} route handlers
tasks.dod: route tests assert 200 for the owner, 404 destinations.not_found identically for another owner's/removed/never-existed ids on both GET and DELETE, 204 on confirmed removal, 401 taking precedence on a confirmed invalid sign-in, 500 on an incomplete removal, and every response matches contracts/openapi.yaml

tasks.title: Register the new routes in the middleware allowlist
tasks.dod: a middleware test (or e2e) confirms /api/v1/destinations and /api/v1/destinations/:path* require a valid sign-in and an unauthenticated request is rejected before reaching the route handler

tasks.title: Build the shared Modal primitive (focus in / focus restore / Escape)
tasks.dod: component tests assert focus moves into the modal on open, returns to the invoking control on close, and Escape closes it; axe-core reports 0 serious/critical violations on the primitive in isolation

tasks.title: Add the destinations client query layer (TanStack Query)
tasks.dod: unit tests assert the query key is ["destinations", userId] with staleTime/gcTime Infinity and retry: false, mutations only update the cache in onSuccess via setQueryData (never optimistically), and a session-invalid response is surfaced as a distinct typed error the container routes on

tasks.title: Build DestinationsContainer (query wiring, error and session routing)
tasks.dod: component tests assert the container renders the loading spinner before the read confirms, routes a confirmed invalid sign-in to sign-in taking precedence over the recoverable-error presentation, and renders the recoverable error on any other read failure

tasks.title: Build DestinationList and DestinationListDrawer (SCR-03, SCR-05)
tasks.dod: component tests assert rows render in recorded order, the add action is present at every width, the narrow-screen drawer opens itself when nothing is selected on a narrow screen, and axe-core reports 0 serious/critical violations on the drawer; a 500-row fixture test asserts every row stays keyboard-reachable and scrolling stays responsive

tasks.title: Build DestinationPicker (SCR-02, add action)
tasks.dod: component tests assert choosing a catalogue entry submits and shows nothing added until the mutation confirms, an unsupported/failed submit shows the inline error without closing, and axe-core reports 0 serious/critical violations

tasks.title: Build RemoveConfirmation (SCR-06)
tasks.dod: component tests assert the destination stays in the list until the removal confirms, a failed removal shows an unambiguous not-removed message while leaving the row intact, and axe-core reports 0 serious/critical violations

tasks.title: Build DestinationDetail, FirstRunScreen and ListUnavailable (SCR-04, SCR-01, SCR-07)
tasks.dod: component tests assert the detail view states nothing recorded yet for both a current and a delisted destination reference, the first-run screen renders only from a confirmed-empty read, and ListUnavailable renders one presentation with a working retry for every non-auth failure cause

tasks.title: Wire the dashboard pages: home and the detail address
tasks.dod: e2e tests assert a reload of a saved detail address reopens the same tracked destination, a not-yours/removed/never-existed address falls back to the plain home address with the one shared message, and an unauthenticated visit to either page redirects to sign-in and returns to the original address after success

tasks.title: Add cross-cutting quality verification (ordering equivalence, 500-entry NFR, timings)
tasks.dod: a test asserts a freshly read list matches the client-spliced list after an add (ordering equivalence, sad.md §11); a single timed test run asserts the list read completes within 500ms and a confirmed add/removal within 800ms against a stubbed network; axe-core runs across all three overlay surfaces together at 0 serious/critical violations
